recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-3760 unless a work group chooses to reopen the broader policy question about OperationOutcome versus application-level response resources.
issue_request: FHIR-3760 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request for DSTU1 asking to clarify when OperationOutcome is appropriate rather than an application-oriented resource such as Contraindication. The accepted resolution was to copy the Contraindication boundary language into OperationOutcome and remove the word "specifically" from the usage introduction.
initial_application: Git-svn commit f0f6a05d8a7599d9a4be1f64d962e8f24ee884c3, matching the Jira-cited SVN revision 5796, explicitly applied #3760 by removing "Specifically" from the OperationOutcome usage list and adding a Boundaries and Relationships section explaining that clinical/workflow issues should use ContraIndication or other resources and that OperationOutcome is not designed to be persisted or referenced from workflow.
additional_context: OperationOutcome and DetectedIssue are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini records that Contraindication became DetectedIssue. Later commits updated the boundary wording from Contraindication to DetectedIssue, refined adjacent scope text without reversing the boundary, and linked the same paragraph to the standard operationoutcome-detectedIssue extension. FHIR-3663 is a broader related role-and-contents issue referenced by Jira, and FHIR-5259 corrected wording in the same OperationOutcome/Contraindication family, but neither requires an additional source edit for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current OperationOutcome introduction is in build scope and already lists current use cases, includes the requested Boundaries and Relationships guidance, uses the modern DetectedIssue name, states that OperationOutcome is not designed to be persisted or referenced from workflow, and no discovered source, git, Zulip, or Confluence evidence contradicts that result.
